name: MiniMax (M2, M2.1, M2.5, M2.7)
notes: XML-ish format: one <minimax:tool_call> section holding one <invoke name="..."> per call, each with <parameter name="..."> elements. String values are raw (no escaping); other values are JSON, so a parser needs the tool schema. The generation prompt always opens <think>, so the completion starts inside the reasoning. M2, M2.1, M2.5 and M2.7 render identical assistant turns (see models). MiniMax-M3 uses a different format and is not part of this family.
